meta.name: The Projectionist

glow.note: icy blue-white lenses (and the eyes behind them) glow; faint cold white at the tips of the arc scars on forearms and hands

meta.note: palace horde: the night projectionist. eyeshade is always worn and goes with the head on a headshot (head_parts); tint instances 0.8-1.1 (head: skin tint); draw eyes unlit; emissiveMap = the glow page at ~1.2; the apron's skirt panels are part of upperLeg.L/R and swing with the legs; the film loops are part of torso and lowerArm.R; lowerLeg.L/R are the trouser legs and shoes (hidden when he crawls). This rig is taller and thinner than the standard: hips 0.97, knees 0.47, shoulders 0.25.
